📺 VisionQuest (2026)

VisionQuest follows Vision, the powerful android from the Avengers, as he embarks on a journey to rediscover his identity and understand what it truly means to be alive. After the events of WandaVision, Vision struggles with fragmented memories, complicated emotions, and questions about his past. As he searches for answers, he encounters familiar figures and unexpected threats that challenge his understanding of humanity and his own existence. Starring Paul Bettany, the Marvel series explores identity, memory, family, and the complicated relationship between artificial intelligence and human emotions.

🎭 Genre: Sci-Fi • Action • Adventure • Superhero

🎥 Creator: Terry Matalas

🎬 Starring: Paul Bettany

📚 Based On: Marvel Comics characters

📺 Where to Watch: Disney+ (planned release).
